arabic text: HO NANA JIS KA SHEHR E ILM OR BAAP USKA DARWAZA
english translation text: THE ONE WHOSE GRANDFATHER IS THE CITY OF KNOWLEDGE AND HIS FATHER IS THE DOOR OF KNOWLEDGE

arabic text: NAHI SAMAJ AATI USS BEKUS KA KYUN TEERO MEIN HAI JANAZA
english translation text: HOW CAN ONE UNDERSTAND HOW HE WAS MARTYRED WHILE HIS DEAD BODY WAS SUPPORTED BY ARROWS!

arabic text: JIDA NA NA ILM DA SHEHR HO WE ATTAY PYU HOWAY DARWAZA
english translation text: THE ONE WHOSE GRANDFATHER IS THE CITY OF KNOWLEDGE AND HIS FATHER IS THE DOOR OF KNOWLEDGE

arabic text: NAHI SAMAJ AANDI USS ZAINAB DA KIWE RULIYA SHAM JANAZA
english translation text: HOW CAN ONE UNDERSTAND WHY BIBI ZAINAB(SA) WAS BURIED IN SHAM

arabic text: KUCH REHEM AGER YE KARLETE IN ZALIMO KA KYA JATA
english translation text: IF ONLY THESE OPPRESSORS COULD HAVE SOME MERCY

arabic text: AIK GHOONT JO PAANI DEY DAITAY MERA ASGHAR TO BACH JATAA
english translation text: IF THEY ONLY GAVE A SIP OF WATER, MY ASGHAR WOULD HAVE BEEN SAVED

arabic text: GHUT PAANI ZAALIM JE DEY DAIDAY MERA ASGHAR TAY BACH JANDA
english translation text: IF THEY ONLY GAVE A SIP OF WATER, MY ASGHAR WOULD HAVE BEEN SAVED

arabic text: KIVAIN KHABAR DEINWA JA SUGRA NOO KITHAY DUBEYA CHAN ZAHRA DAA
english translation text: HOW CAN I TELL BIBI SUGHRA ABOUT HOW BIBI ZAHRA’S SON WAS MARTYRED

arabic text: MAKTAL MEIN ROOTEE JATEE THEE KARTI
english translation text: THEE BABA BABA\nIN MAQTAL (BIBI SAKINA) WAS DESPERATELY CRYING AND CALLING 'FATHER,FATHER!'

arabic text: EIK LAASHE SE AWAAZ AAI AA MERI GHOOD MEIN AJAA
english translation text: A HEADLESS BODY REPLIED BACK 'COME IN MY LAP'

arabic text: MAKTAL VICH DIGDE DHEINDE RAEE DEINDE PYU NU AWWASAN
english translation text: IN MAQTAL (BIBI SAKINA) WAS DESPERATELY CRYING AND CALLING 'FATHER,FATHER!'

arabic text: EIK LAASHAY TON AWWAZ AIYE AA MERI LASSH TE AAJA
english translation text: A HEADLESS BODY REPLIED BACK 'COME IN MY LAP'

arabic text: FARYAD KARE NALE ZAAR ROWE JEIDI LAADLI AUN DI MAA DI\n(SAKINA)
english translation text: CRYING AND COMPLAINING TO BIBI ZAINAB

arabic text: NAHI LABDA BABA MAKTAL VICH KATTI GARDAN AE LAASHA DI
english translation text: COMPLAINING… THAT ALL DEAD BODIES ARE HEADLESS AND SHE CAN’T FIND HER FATHER
